content_sections.heading: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: LLB. Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council. Experience at the Bar of handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts. An unconditional willingness/consent to work on the general terms & conditions approved by the Government of India from time to time. A minimum standing of 10 years as an Advocate is required for considering an advocate for CBI Special Public Prosecutor, along with details of important criminal cases handled by the applicant. Experience in conducting trials of cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, is a mandatory pre-condition. Eligible candidates shall be required to be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated. No travelling allowance or reimbursement of travel expenses shall be admissible for attending the Court.

content_sections.heading: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Eligibility is instead based on a minimum standing of 10 years as a practicing Advocate with relevant criminal-trial experience, as detailed in the Eligibility section above.

content_sections.heading: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted online along with the prescribed proforma and supporting documents; only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction by CBI. The proposal for engagement is also subject to approval, as recorded in the prescribed proforma, from DOP/CBI, the Director, CBI, and the Learned Attorney General.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The complete application, in the prescribed proforma format, along with the requisite documents, should be submitted through the online link for the relevant trial court location. Incomplete applications and applications submitted offline shall not be considered. No application shall be entertained by CBI if submitted after the last date of submission. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction by CBI. The last date of receipt of online applications is 08 October 2026 for all four locations (Lucknow, Jabalpur, Ghaziabad, Coimbatore).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The following documents may be submitted along with the application: Educational Qualifications Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council Experience at the Bar of handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts An unconditional willingness/consent to work on the general terms & conditions approved by the Government of India from time to time Details of important cases handled by the applicant advocate Details of cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, handled by the applicant advocate Applicants must also fill the prescribed Proforma for Appointment/Engagement of Special Public Prosecutor for CBI, which requires details including: name, date of birth, residence and office address, educational qualifications, date of enrolment as an Advocate, experience on the criminal side (at Bar, number of criminal cases handled, and cases appeared on behalf of CBI/Central Government/State Government departments, broken down by Subordinate Courts, High Courts and Supreme Court), a list of important cases handled (including under-trial cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988), cases where success was achieved, current workload, whether currently working as a Panel Lawyer/Standing Counsel/Legal Advisor for any Central or State Government Ministry/Department/Organisation, and the approval status of the proposal.

content_sections.heading: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 General Instructions
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates shall be required to be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated; no travelling allowance or reimbursement of travel expenses shall be admissible for attending the Court. Incomplete applications and applications submitted offline shall not be considered. No application shall be entertained after the last date of submission. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction by CBI. The document is marked "Confidential" by the CBI Policy Division.

faq.question: Q1. What is CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement drive by CBI's Policy Division, New Delhi, to create a panel of advocates as Special Public Prosecutors to conduct trial of Lokpal-referred CBI cases before the Special Judge, CBI, at Lucknow, Jabalpur, Ghaziabad, and Coimbatore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: An LLB degree, enrollment as an Advocate with the Bar Council, and experience at the Bar handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts, along with a minimum of 10 years' standing as an Advocate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of online applications is 08 October 2026 for all four locations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the engagement period for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum engagement period is 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are submitted online with the prescribed proforma and documents; only shortlisted candidates are called for an interaction by CBI. No written exam is specified.

faq.question: Q6. Is travelling allowance provided for attending the Court?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that no travelling allowance or reimbursement of travel expenses shall be admissible for attending the Court, and eligible candidates must be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated.
